title: A Speech to Remember
text:
Last year, a young teacher named Maria gave a speech at her school's graduation ceremony. She talked about the importance of kindness and hard work. Many students said it was the best speech they had ever heard.

Maria did not use any notes. Instead, she told a short story about her first day at school, when she was very nervous. Her speech lasted only ten minutes, but everyone remembered it for a long time.

questions.text: What did Maria talk about in her speech?
options: The importance of kindness and hard work

questions.text: How long did Maria's speech last?
Why did Maria probably tell a story about her first day at school?
options: To help the audience feel connected to her

questions.text: What can be inferred about Maria's speaking style?
options: She felt confident speaking without notes
She was afraid to speak in public
She read every word from a paper
She did not prepare at all

the quality of being friendly and caring towards others
worried or anxious about something that is going to happen

paragraph_translations: No ano passado, uma jovem professora chamada Maria fez um discurso na cerimônia de formatura de sua escola. Ela falou sobre a importância da gentileza e do trabalho duro. Muitos alunos disseram que foi o melhor discurso que já tinham ouvido.

Maria não usou nenhuma anotação. Em vez disso, contou uma breve história sobre o seu primeiro dia na escola, quando estava muito nervosa. Seu discurso durou apenas dez minutos, mas todos o lembraram por muito tempo.
